About this model

Educational 3D reconstruction of the original Sense. Package shapes and placement are approximate. Highlighted lines are logical electrical nets, not exact copper tracks. Passive circuits are grouped where indicated. No live hardware readings.

Official circuit schematic ↗Based on Arduino NANO33BLE V4.0 schematic (CC BY-SA 4.0). U4 is marked DNP and is not a fitted crypto chip.
